Activity: Define purpose, legal basis and categories of personal and inferred data
Acceptance criterion: 100% of data categories with purpose and legal basis recorded before data access
Artifact: Privacy requirements sheet (versioned); record of processing

Activity: Screen and open the DPIA/RIPD, including AI-specific risks
Acceptance criterion: DPIA opened whenever screening meets >= 2 high-risk criteria; each risk rated for likelihood and impact

Activity: Minimize attributes and records against the purpose
Acceptance criterion: Every retained attribute justified against the purpose; removed attributes logged

Activity: Anonymize, pseudonymize or synthesize data in proportion to risk
Acceptance criterion: k, l, t (or epsilon, delta) recorded; re-identification risk below the register threshold; zero replications of unique records in synthetic data (example)

Activity: Select the training PET by risk and adversary
Acceptance criterion: Each PET traced to a register risk; privacy budget (epsilon,delta) fixed and justified before training
Artifact: PET decision record; privacy parameter log

Activity: Record provenance and legal basis per dataset and model version
Acceptance criterion: Every model version traceable to its dataset versions and legal bases

Activity: Test privacy leakage (membership inference, model inversion)
Acceptance criterion: Attack success (e.g. membership-inference AUC) at or below the register threshold
Artifact: Attack test report; residual risk score

Activity: Test fairness and formally accept residual risk
Acceptance criterion: Demographic parity >= 0.80 (example); residual risk accepted by controller and DPO before release

Activity: Inform data subjects and enable review of automated decisions
Acceptance criterion: 100% of automated decisions with explanation and a human review channel

Activity: Enforce access control and protected inference
Acceptance criterion: Least-privilege access reviewed at release; inference and access logs retained

Activity: Reassess privacy risk on triggers (retraining, drift, new purpose)
Acceptance criterion: DPIA updated before every redeployment that follows a trigger

Activity: Handle data subject requests, retention and disposal
Acceptance criterion: Requests answered within the legal deadline; data disposed of at end of purpose, with proof of erasure
Artifact: Request log; retention and disposal report

Acceptance criterion: Incidents communicated to the ANPD and data subjects within the regulatory deadline
Roles (DPO, product owner) assigned; 100% of activities linked to a gap and a regulatory clause
